en: A museum art postcard reproducing a Renaissance-style painting in warm golden tones showing a mythological scene: a seated smith (Vulcan) forging, a nude child (Cupid) beside him, and a standing woman; riders and a pastoral landscape with hills and trees in the background. The reverse carries Romanian museum and postal markings from the Socialist Republic era and the painting's title/attribution.
